text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you mind if I step outside for a bit?
I feel like getting some fresh air...
choice_data_list: If we go, we go together.
If you're going, we're going together!
Let's hold our review meeting here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you mind if I step outside for a bit?
I feel like getting some fresh air...
choice_data_list: If we go, we go together.
If you're going, we're going together!
Let's hold our review meeting here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I'm alright. I don't intend to trouble you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Why?
Even though the reason for this losing streak lies with me.
choice_data_list: The summit isn't so simple that you can reach it alone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. To reach even greater heights, please lend me your strength, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Braving the cold wind with Grass Wonder,
we exchanged our honest thoughts about today's defeat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...If possible, I'd like to leave this place.
Even though I know it's selfish of me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In this waiting room that I return to after losing so many times...
I feel as though frustration permeates the air.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Don't run from it—let this frustration carve itself into your memory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Without running away, you say?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Understood. To ensure we never taste bitter defeat again, I will accept this frustration for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Grass Wonder and I
went over our areas of improvement from today's race.
